snippet.title: Bad Badger - Official Reveal Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026
snippet.description: Don't miss the Reveal Trailer for Bad Badger, an open-world comedic sandbox game developed by Yak & Co. Players will embody one bad Honey Badger by smashing out of your enclosure and wreaking havoc across an Open-Zoo sandbox. Break, escape, sneak, smash, steal, ride, trick & taunt. BE BAD! Bad Badger is coming soon to PC (Steam).
